title: 第13章 关于祖龙的传闻体质的秘密第14章 始皇的猜疑最后的机缘
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
赢天无奈的说道：“前辈有时间在这里威胁我，还不如早点，进入寄灵空间。”
“这样我也好继续完成我的训练计划。”
“桀桀桀~本座期待你的表现。”
说完一道黑光从始皇体内涌出，直奔赢天体内的寄灵空间而去。
赢天看着进入寄灵空间的身影问道：“前辈，您还未告诉我，你的名字呢？”
言罢，一道声音从赢天体内传出。
“哈哈哈哈~本座魔祖~罗睺。”
当魔祖罗喉彻底融入到，赢天的体内之后。
赢天的眉心处，突然缓缓的冒出了一个，黑色神秘的印记。
这印记，让赢天本就孤傲霸道的气质，增添了几分邪气凛然的魔性。
整个人看起来，变得更加出尘，更加神秘了起来。
再配上那俊美无双的容貌和一头白色长发，璀璨的金眸。
这容貌，这气质，简直男女通杀。ˉ﹃ˉ
赢天在仔细的感受了一会儿身体的变化后，再次睁开金眸，缓缓说道：“其他四位，还不准备现身吗？”
话音刚落，两道金光突然从始皇体内，冲了出来。
两道无比威严的身影，直接出现在赢天的面前。
随着这两位的出现，本就风云剧变的练武场，再次变得燥热起来。
一股股热浪，向着四面八方扩散。
并且周围的温度，还在持续的往上飙升，丝毫没有一点停下来的意思。
妖帝帝俊看着赢天，感慨道：“没想到，这次竟然让那十个莽夫，领了先。”

“多少有点晦气啊~”
东皇太一，闻言淡笑道：“呵呵~兄长何必在意这些。”
“这又不是什么大道之争，还得分个先来后到。”
“如今，巫妖两族，已成为历史，能否再次重现昔日光辉，都是一个未解之谜。”
“何必再为以前的那些恩怨，乱了心境。”
妖帝帝俊闻言笑道：“二弟倒是比为兄看得开，倒是为兄着相了。”
东皇太一看着，身旁微微皱眉的赢天，开口道：“好了兄长，有什么事以后再说吧。”
“这位赢天小友，已经等急了。”
妖帝帝俊闻言，微微点头，随后两人化作一道金光进入了赢天的寄灵空间之中。
在看到两人进入寄灵空间后。
赢天喃喃自语道：“与十二祖巫不对付，还提到了巫妖两族，看来应该就是那两位了。”
“接下来又是谁呢？”
content_en:
Yingtian said helplessly: "Senior has time to threaten me here, so it is better to enter the spirit space as soon as possible."
"This way I can continue to complete my training plan."
"Jie Jie Jie ~ I look forward to your performance."
After speaking, a black light emerged from the body of the First Emperor and went straight to the spiritual space in Yingtian's body.
Yingtian looked at the figure entering the spirit space and asked: "Senior, you haven't told me yet, where is your name?"
After saying this, a voice came from Yingtian's body.
"Hahahaha~ I am the Demon Ancestor~ Luo Hu."
When Demon Ancestor Luohou was completely integrated into Yingtian's body.
A mysterious black mark suddenly appeared slowly between Yingtian's eyebrows.
This mark added a bit of evil and evil nature to Yingtian's already aloof and domineering temperament.
The whole person seemed to have become more out-of-this-world and mysterious.
Coupled with that unparalleled handsome appearance, long white hair, and dazzling golden eyes.
This appearance and temperament are simply unisex. ˉ﹃ˉ
After Yingtian carefully felt the changes in his body for a while, he opened his golden eyes again and said slowly: "Aren't the other four ready to show up?"
As soon as he finished speaking, two golden lights suddenly rushed out from the First Emperor's body.
Two extremely majestic figures appeared directly in front of Yingtian.
With the appearance of these two men, the already undergoing drastic changes in the martial arts training ground became heated again.
Waves of heat spread in all directions.
And the surrounding temperature continues to soar, with no intention of stopping at all.
Demon Emperor Dijun looked at Yingtian and sighed: "I didn't expect that these ten reckless men would take the lead this time."
"It's a bit unlucky~"
Donghuang Taiyi smiled lightly when he heard this and said: "Haha~ Brother, why should you care about this?"
"This is not a battle between avenues. It's all about first come, first served."
"Today, the Lich and Lich clans have become history. Whether they can regain their former glory again is an unsolved mystery."
"Why bother worrying about those past grievances anymore."
Demon Emperor Di Jun heard this and said with a smile: "The second brother is more tolerant than the elder brother, but he is more concerned about the elder brother."
Donghuang Taiyi looked at Yingtian, who was frowning slightly beside him, and said, "Okay, brother, let's talk about it later if you have anything to do."
"This little friend Yingtian has been waiting impatiently."
Demon Emperor Dijun nodded slightly when he heard the words, and then the two of them turned into a golden light and entered Yingtian's spirit space.
After seeing the two people enter the spirit space.
Ying Tian murmured to himself: "I don't want to deal with the Twelve Ancestral Witches, and I also mentioned the two Lich clans. It seems that they should be those two."
"Who's next?"
